mapper.select: INSERT INTO rate_limits(bucket,window_start,attempts) VALUES(#{bucket},#{now},1) ON CONFLICT(bucket) DO UPDATE SET attempts=CASE WHEN rate_limits.window_start<=#{cutoff} THEN 1 ELSE rate_limits.attempts+1 END, window_start=CASE WHEN rate_limits.window_start<=#{cutoff} THEN excluded.window_start ELSE rate_limits.window_start END RETURNING attempts
SELECT bucket,window_start,attempts FROM rate_limits WHERE bucket=#{bucket}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rate_limits(bucket,window_start,attempts) VALUES(#{bucket},#{now},1) ON CONFLICT(bucket) DO UPDATE SET attempts=CASE WHEN excluded.window_start-rate_limits.window_start>=#{resetAfterSeconds} THEN 1 ELSE rate_limits.attempts+1 END, window_start=excluded.window_start
